en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's get some fresh air
Let's go for a run
Let's go back inside

I have to tell you something. Ever since I was
born, I was never able to taste food.

So when I eat curry or sushi,
I don't taste anything...
That's why, I can't taste the air...

Oh, Shuichi!
Do you have any food that you prefer?

I like sweets!
But, spicy is good too!
<CLT=cltMIND>...

Eeehhh...
I'm not in the mood, so I'll pass.
By the way, I'm not lying. Okay?
We think alike, Shuichi!

I didn't feel like going outside today,
but then you invited me.

So right when I was thinking about
how inconsiderate you were...

...you used your <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s
intuition and saw right through me! Wow!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
